mechanics.claim: Udyr enters Claw Stance, empowering his next two basic attacks to deal bonus on-hit physical damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Udyr''' enters ''Claw Stance'', empowering his next two basic attacks to gain {{sti|range|50}} '''bonus''' range and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts on cast, but using the recast (Awaken) refreshes it.
mechanics.quote: Starts on-cast, but recasting refreshes the cooldown

mechanics.claim: Deals spell damage on the primary target and applies area damage on the lightning strikes.
mechanics.quote: Deals {{tip|spell damage}} to the primary target and applies {{tip|area damage}} on the lightning strikes.

mechanics.claim: The lightning strikes can bounce to and hit the same single target multiple times when no other enemies are nearby, stacking their damage.
mechanics.quote: chaining to up to 3 nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies and being able to hit the same target multiple times

mechanics.claim: If both empowered attacks are used on the same isolated target, the lightning damage from both can stack on it.
mechanics.quote: If both empowered attacks are used on the same isolated target, the lightning strikes can deal up to {{as|{{pp|3*6 + (6*6-3*6)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}}|health}}

mechanics.claim: A spell shield only blocks the lightning-strike portion of an empowered attack, not necessarily the base on-hit damage.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block an empowered attack's application of the lightning strikes.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attacks are not triggered or consumed if they hit a structure/ward or are parried.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attacks will not trigger nor be consumed if they hit a structure or ward or are parried.

mechanics.claim: The Awaken recast's empowered attacks and lightning strikes must be used within 4 seconds of the recast.
